$comment: A board with a walkthrough whose third beat is about the part that is going away.

nodes.name: Jinja environment
nodes.responsibility: The app's Jinja environment and render_template

walkthroughs.name: How a page is built
walkthroughs.summary: From a view's call to a rendered page

beats.heading: One request, one page
beats.body: A view function asks for a template and gets a string back. This walkthrough follows that call.

beats.heading: The app asks Jinja
beats.body: render_template looks the template up in the app's Jinja environment, which is created lazily with the app's loader.

beats.heading: The engine renders
beats.body: The template engine compiles the template and renders it with the context the view supplied.
